svg.title: On 10 of 15 rivers and ship channels, fewer than half of the large ships at the entrance reach the head port

cc:Work.dc:title: On 10 of 15 rivers and ship channels, fewer than half of the large ships at the entrance reach the head port
cc:Work.dc:description: Dot chart with one row per river or ship channel, showing distinct large ships at the entrance (gray) and at the head port (blue); the gap is largest on the James, Hudson, Sacramento, Mississippi, Delaware, and Houston corridors.
